title: Add Message-Authenticator validation to the radius dissector.
description: Add validation of the Message-Authenticator attribute to the radius dissector.

notes.body: We should ensure that tvb_length is >= (offset + AUTHENTICATOR_LENGTH) otherwise we have a heap buffer overflow here

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/13013/diffs?diff_id=833638922&start_sha=4bd52144ccad8e05dec5c5506d844439a6fd3fb3#8a594fffc5e2852363cf1e8acce98e453be4c037_1409_1411)

you likely do not want to check the message authentication if not all packet data was captured (tvb_reported_length() != tvb_captured_length()), or taht ou have enough data using tvb_bytes_exist() for example.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/13013/diffs?diff_id=833638922&start_sha=4bd52144ccad8e05dec5c5506d844439a6fd3fb3#8a594fffc5e2852363cf1e8acce98e453be4c037_1401_1403)
The 2 issues above are also present in the existing valid_authenticator function. We should probably fix both. Agreed?

If there is this code pattern somewhere else, yes definitely.
Is there a way to factorize this code with the existing one to avoid too much duplication?
Did a refactor, not really sure if it's better.
Not sure either after seeing the result, but let's not undo what was done :)

Does it deserve a specific preference or should it be added to the validate_authenticator one? I'm not familiar wit the protocol so simply let me know what makes most sense to you.

I initially thought it would make more sense to have to different ones since it's a different check. But since it's basically for the same purpose ( checking if PSK is correct and authenticator/message-authenticator are calculated successfully ) i think one option will suffice.
